assets.name: vernier-ruler-tile
assets.alt: Brass vernier ruler tile: a graduated strip with a tall notch and seven smaller ticks.
assets.notes: Vernier ruler (brief 3.C). One tile = one experiment interval, 160x40. Repeat horizontally (background-repeat: repeat-x or one inline copy per EXP) with the tall notch at the left of each tile; EXP-001..EXP-008 are eight tiles and EXP-009+ just add more. The seam is drawn so tiles join without a gap. Labels are HTML placed above or below the notch. Inline the SVG in the page (or use it as mask-image with background-color: var(--bench-brass)): the pieces set their colour from --bench-brass / --bench-line / --bench-line-soft with currentColor fallbacks, which a plain cannot reach.

assets.name: vernier-ruler-cap-start
assets.alt: Left end plate of the brass vernier ruler, with a screw head.
assets.notes: Left cap of the ruler, 24x40; place before the first tile. Inline the SVG in the page (or use it as mask-image with background-color: var(--bench-brass)): the pieces set their colour from --bench-brass / --bench-line / --bench-line-soft with currentColor fallbacks, which a plain cannot reach.

assets.name: vernier-ruler-cap-end
assets.alt: Right end plate of the brass vernier ruler, with a screw head.
assets.notes: Right cap of the ruler, 24x40 (mirror of the left cap); place after the last tile. Inline the SVG in the page (or use it as mask-image with background-color: var(--bench-brass)): the pieces set their colour from --bench-brass / --bench-line / --bench-line-soft with currentColor fallbacks, which a plain cannot reach.

assets.name: vernier-cursor
assets.alt: Brass slider with an empty window, a hairline and a pointer, for the vernier ruler.
assets.notes: Vernier slider, 56x84. The hairline at x=28 (half the width) marks the selected notch; centre it on the notch with translateX(-50%). Its window is open: the ruler shows through. Inline the SVG in the page (or use it as mask-image with background-color: var(--bench-brass)): the pieces set their colour from --bench-brass / --bench-line / --bench-line-soft with currentColor fallbacks, which a plain cannot reach.

assets.name: pipe-straight
assets.alt: A straight brass pipe segment with flanges, engraving style.
assets.notes: Connection piece (brief 3.A, builtWith). 80x44; the pipe centreline is y=22 and the ends are x=0 and x=80, so segments butt end to end. Repeat or scale horizontally; rotate 90 degrees for vertical runs. Inline the SVG in the page (or use it as mask-image with background-color: var(--bench-brass)): the pieces set their colour from --bench-brass / --bench-line / --bench-line-soft with currentColor fallbacks, which a plain cannot reach.

assets.name: pipe-elbow
assets.alt: A quarter-turn brass pipe elbow with flanges, engraving style.
assets.notes: Connection piece, 44x64. Enters from the left at y=22 (x=0) and leaves downward at x=22 (y=64), exactly where pipe-vertical has its centreline; rotate or mirror for the other turns. Inline the SVG in the page (or use it as mask-image with background-color: var(--bench-brass)): the pieces set their colour from --bench-brass / --bench-line / --bench-line-soft with currentColor fallbacks, which a plain cannot reach.

assets.name: pipe-vertical
assets.alt: A vertical brass pipe segment with flanges, engraving style.
assets.notes: Connection piece, 44x80: pipe-straight turned to run down, centreline x=22, ends y=0 and y=80, hatching kept on the right. Stack or stretch vertically below an elbow (exit x=22). Inline the SVG in the page (or use it as mask-image with background-color: var(--bench-brass)): the pieces set their colour from --bench-brass / --bench-line / --bench-line-soft with currentColor fallbacks, which a plain cannot reach.

assets.name: pipe-tee
assets.alt: A brass pipe tee with flanges and a boss at the junction, engraving style.
assets.notes: Connection piece, 80x64. Enters left and right at y=22 (x=0 and x=80) and branches downward at x=40 (y=64); a pipe-vertical hung under the branch has its left edge at x=18 of the tee (its centreline x=22 lands on x=40). Inline the SVG in the page (or use it as mask-image with background-color: var(--bench-brass)): the pieces set their colour from --bench-brass / --bench-line / --bench-line-soft with currentColor fallbacks, which a plain cannot reach.

assets.name: belt-span
assets.alt: A flat leather transmission belt span with stitch ticks and a buckle, engraving style.
assets.notes: Connection piece, 160x44, centreline y=22 like the pipes, so belts and pipes share a baseline. Stretch or repeat horizontally; rotate 90 degrees for vertical spans. Tie it to the pulleys of the plates with HTML positioning. Inline the SVG in the page (or use it as mask-image with background-color: var(--bench-brass)): the pieces set their colour from --bench-brass / --bench-line / --bench-line-soft with currentColor fallbacks, which a plain cannot reach.
